description: One vault’s depositors month by month: how many addresses, how many with a stated result, the median monthly return (modified Dietz), the summed result, deposits, withdrawals and net flow. Balances are read from 24 Sep 2026 and flows name their address from 5 Nov 2026; the median is over addresses with a stated result only, and a vault whose realised rate is refused as implausible states none. FREE.
